metadata.title: Identifying the contextual factors related to the reading performance of Moroccan fourth-grade students from a Machine Learning-based Approach.

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study converts multiple plausible values into a single majority-vote benchmark-based reading proficiency class, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in its analysis of the ILSA microdata.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to model individual students without using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as train/test split and cross-validation, indicating that it did not validate its findings on an external dataset.
